description: Generate a .pptx slide deck from Markdown or plain text (params ≤1MiB): every heading line (# to ######) starts a new slide as its title; list items (- / 1.) and other non-empty lines become bullet points on the current slide (• for plain lines, native auto-numbering for ordered items; **bold** and `code` run inline). Tables and images are not rendered — pipe rows are kept as literal bullet text, nothing is dropped. One layout (title + bullets), 16:9. Limits: 200 slides, 100000 inline runs, 8MiB output. Returns {content_base64, bytes, filename}

filename.description: Output file name, optional (default slides.pptx; .pptx enforced)

name: make_pptx
